data.one_liner: A simple flutter countdown timer widget with support for controllers and custom builders.
data.what_it_does: Provides Countdown and CountdownTimer widgets to count down through a target timestamp or duration. It supports end-of-countdown events, custom builders, millisecond animations, and controllers to start, stop, or reset the timer.
use_when: You need to display a countdown timer in your UI with optional custom formatting.
You want to trigger specific callbacks when a countdown timer reaches zero.
avoid_when: You need complex background time tracking or background services independent of widget life cycles.
strengths: Easy to integrate into simple widgets or ListView builders.
Provides both a simple timestamp countdown and a controller-driven duration countdown.
Allows custom UI rendering via widgetBuilder.
weaknesses: Limited built-in styling compared to specialized wheel or picker libraries.
